services.title: Provided services
services.intro: Use the platform, get support for a silicon prototype or connect GENESIS to your own tools.

subscription.label: How your subscription fits together
subscription.hint: Select a part to see its scope.

parts.title: GENESIS software
parts.detail: Your subscription licenses the agreed GENESIS modules for your team. It is software access, not a chip design delivered on your behalf.
items: Design, simulation and optimization modules selected for your team.
Access for the users and license term stated in your offer.
Documentation, software updates and product support as specified in your subscription.

parts.title: Your environment
parts.detail: GENESIS works with your design tools and infrastructure. Their licenses and access rights are separate from the software subscription.
items: Authorized PDK access and device models.
Compute and storage in your environment, or hosting agreed separately.

parts.title: Additional services
parts.detail: Need help beyond using the software? Engineering work and additional resources are scoped separately, so you know what each engagement covers.
items: Custom tool integration, deployment and training.
Managed compute or EM resources, where agreed.
Prototype planning, fabrication preparation and measurement support.

steps.title: Agree the scope
steps.detail: We confirm your users, modules, toolchain and subscription terms before you commit.

steps.title: Prepare your environment
steps.detail: We review compatibility and the installation requirements. You arrange the required tool licenses, PDK access and infrastructure.

steps.title: Set up your first project
steps.detail: Software delivery, access setup and onboarding follow the scope agreed with your team.

items.label: Software
items.title: Software subscription
items.headline: GENESIS access for your design team.
items.description: License GENESIS annually, per user, for use in your design environment. Choose the software modules your team needs, with access, delivery and support defined before you start.

features.title: User access
features.detail: Your offer lists the enabled modules, number of users and license term. Third-party CAD and solver licenses are not included.

features.title: Software delivery
features.detail: Installation requirements, documentation and access to software releases are defined for your supported environment.

features.title: Product support
features.detail: Support channels, availability and onboarding are agreed in your subscription. Circuit design consulting is a separate service.

items.note: We confirm the price, included modules, update policy and support terms in your offer. Compute, custom integration and fabrication are not bundled into the software license.

items.label: Silicon support
items.title: Silicon demonstration assistance
items.headline: Take your design to silicon.
items.description: Technical support with prototype planning, fabrication preparation and measurement.

features.title: Prototype planning
features.detail: Define what the prototype needs to demonstrate and identify process and test requirements.

features.title: Fabrication preparation
features.detail: Review design requirements and prepare the technical handoff for fabrication.

features.title: Measurement support
features.detail: Plan the measurements and compare bench results with the simulation models.

items.note: Fabrication, packaging and lab access are scoped separately for each project.

items.label: Integration
items.title: Specialised integration
items.headline: Your tools. Working together.
items.description: Connect GENESIS to your CAD tools, automation scripts and existing design workflows.

features.title: CAD and solver workflows
features.detail: Connect supported design tools and solvers through explicit configurations and runners.

features.title: Your automation
features.detail: Bring existing scripts and design routines into a repeatable workflow.

features.title: Deployment on your terms
features.detail: Define data boundaries, tool access and validation around your own environment.

items.note: Integration scope depends on your toolchain, licenses and deployment requirements.
